root_cause: Not the Heavy scoring itself: at both findings the planner first REFUSED Lootas Alpha its pick in the capture pass and left it over. s7462 r1 P2: LONE-TRIP refused obj_center ('not going alone ... ~30 enemy OC vs the 10 OC we would have') although Lootas Beta was already assigned ADVANCE obj_center (LONE-TRIP only counts units that arrive no later; Beta needs 3 turns, Alpha 2) and Kommandos + Mek Beta were sent there later in the same plan; the support fallback then picked obj_nml_1 (Move, 3 turns) and T7-26 held the unit still for +1 to hit (dist 25.6" > 2 moves, so the Heavy override never yields). s7463 r1 P2: obj_center (its top candidate, 27.9) needed no more OC after the two Battlewagons, obj_nml_1 was RACE-SKIPped (57 enemy OC), and the leftover became a T7-42 corridor block (score 9.7) 26" from obj_nml_2. Common thread: a round-1 Heavy-armed ranged leftover is parked (support side objective + Heavy hold, or corridor block) instead of joining the plan's own push on the centre it reaches in 2 turns. Where B gained (f1, 2 seeds, effect +11.0 both seeds): in round 2 the deciding Orks scored Consecrate hold_more +4 and the opponent lost Triangulation hold_min (-4): Lootas Alpha's 10 OC at the centre swung objective control; no secondary-card or kill differences.
fix_summary: FIX_RANGED_CENTRE (default 1.0) in _assign_units_to_objectives, leftover loop, before screen/corridor-block/support: in battle round 1 only, for ONE unit per plan that (a) the capture pass refused its pick (extra_obj_skipped: DIM-RETURNS/TOO-LATE/RACE-SKIP/LONE-TRIP/FAR-TRIP), (b) has ranged weapons, is not a melee seeker, and has Heavy weapons (_get_unit_heavy_weapon_data.has_heavy), (c) has a move/advance candidate to the objective within 4" of the board centre with turns_to_reach <= 2 that is not TOO-LATE / RACE-SKIP, and (d) the plan already sends another unit there (assignments move/advance or incoming movers): assign it that candidate (its own action, Advance at all findings), assign_pass 'ranged_centre', log [RANGED_CENTRE]. Value 0 restores the base exactly (the block is skipped). ~45 lines, no scoring change.

fires: Replays (8 games, A branch, rounds 1-2, both players): 7 fires, all round 1, all Lootas: s7462 r1p2 2 (P2 Lootas Alpha = finding; P1 Lootas Alpha), s7463 1 (finding), s7460 1 (finding), s7490 1 (P1 Lootas Gamma), s7466 1 (P2 Lootas Alpha), s7462 r1p1 1 (P1 Lootas Alpha), s7470 0, s7435 0 -> ~0.9 per game, max 1 per player-phase observed. Bench (step 9b, mirror_orks_2000_postdeploy, seed 93101, 1 pair): 0 fires in BOTH games ([RANGED_CENTRE] grep count 0/0); the pair is identical (margin -23 in both seat orders, 589 actions each). Reason checked with a round-1 probe of the fixture: the bench Orks list (Stompa, Wazdakka, Deffkoptas, Stormboyz, Warbikers, Gretchin, Mek, Deffkilla Wartrikes) has no Lootas; the leftover/refused units there (Gretchin, Mek, Wartrikes, Deffkoptas) have no Heavy weapons, so the Heavy gate excludes them.
risks: (1) Bench reach is 0 in the Orks mirror (no Lootas in the bench list); the asym and Custodes fixtures were not probed - the full-game bench cannot measure this fix as is, and widening the Heavy gate to make it fire would hit Gretchin/Mek/Burna Boyz leftovers that no finding covers. (2) It overrides LONE-TRIP for a fragile unit (Lootas: 1-wound models) whenever ANY friendly unit is sent to the centre, even one that arrives a turn later; if that friend dies or is diverted the Lootas stand alone in a ~30-OC centre (LONE-TRIP's original failure mode, round 3 lesson). (3) Advancing gives up the round-1 shooting of a Heavy unit (Deffguns); measured value is only to the end of round 2 (primary hold_more/hold_min swing); later-round effects (losing a 10-model shooting unit at the centre in round 2-3, vs secondary cards like Centre Ground that it helps) are unmeasured. (4) In mirrors it also changes the opponent's Lootas (both seats fire), and moves other units' screen/block targets in the same phase (s7462 r1p1). (5) One-per-plan cap is per re-plan: a later unit in the same phase can fire again after the first has moved (not observed above: max 1 per player-phase in 8 games).
